text: Live, so far: minus 565 dollars and 7 cents on a hundred thousand dollar paper account. Four condors open, twenty eight contracts, three thousand one hundred and eight dollars of credit collected, against a worst case capped at ten thousand eight hundred and forty. The tail hedge is coded and never engaged: no VIX expiry inside its window was quoted all week. In ninety minutes the agent flattens the book and that number becomes realised.
